answer: Proof of uplink bandwidth: each epoch the beacon picks a yarrow-random second and five verifiers who each pull 40 MB of identity-unique pseudorandom data from every key within 10 s. Keys sharing one uplink split its throughput, so a 1,000-key farm needs ~32 Gbps of burst capacity, roughly $2,000/month, versus ~3 POA per passing answer, a net loss. A missed pull starts a ripple of 3 frozen payout epochs; one tide of misses demotes the key to probation.
